subject: Don't plan on pre-ordering
author: thephilofwar
body:
I stopped pre-ordering games a while back since it sets yourself up for a commitment not to the game, but to giving that specific store your money. Often times, a store will have a better price than competitors, so I wait til the week of the game and check the ads to see if anyone has a slight edge...when I buy new games I end up getting them sometime during the week of release, or the weeks that follow.
